sources.title: TikTok playable ads guidance
sources.notes: Profile uses a deterministic index.html + config.json ZIP, responsive orientation value 0 (both portrait and landscape), and the exact TikTok Playable SDK host script.

sources.title: TikTok playable preview guidance
sources.notes: Official Ads Manager preview and physical-device acceptance remain unexecuted external gates.

uploadSize.notes: Conservative decimal 5 MB limit on the exact compressed upload.

packaging.notes: Flat deterministic ZIP containing only index.html and config.json with Playable_orientation=0.

inline.notes: Only the exact declared SDK URL is external; media and game code are inline.

mraid.notes: TikTok uses its Playable SDK, not MRAID.

vendorHost.notes: Deliberate CTA invokes window.openAppStore() or playableSDK.openAppStore().

autoplay.notes: Local runtime gates audio and timing on interaction and visibility.

firstClick.notes: No automatic redirect; only the authored CTA opens the app store.

viewability.notes: Document visibility is the local runtime/mock-host lifecycle contract.

orientations.notes: config.json sets Playable_orientation=0 (both portrait and landscape), and Creative QA verifies all four viewports.

value.instructions: Preview the exact ZIP in the official TikTok workflow and on physical devices. Verify SDK loading, portrait presentation, audio, background/resume, end card, and deliberate openAppStore CTA. No official result is implied.

companionAssets.notes: Campaign assets and store configuration remain in Ads Manager.
